sequence: Instrument existing CPU/Metal coarse paths with exclusive stages
Measure pilot before selecting the GPU migration
Freeze the selected implementation and benchmark sources
Run serial fresh-process comparisons with forward/reverse matched-order blocks for profiling on/off overhead; no same-process overhead claim.
selection: Prioritize measured wall-time share, preserving exact gray8/NCC outputs; report scene dependence. Do not infer bottlenecks solely from image dimensions.

accuracy.all_saved_calls: Every first and measured call must match frozen baseline output exactly. Independently check known synthetic truth; Src7 agreement is not calibrated accuracy.
accuracy.known_truth: No extra or missed detections and <=2 pixels / 1 degree / 2 percent scale on final outputs. Never feed truth into selection or kernels.

performance.easy_scene_regression_limit: max(10 percent, 2 ms) warm whole-pipeline median; report raw samples and any failed gates
performance.claim: Require repeatable improvement in the targeted measured bottleneck and report total wall time; improvements are not assumed universal.

memory: Separate peak process RSS, retained host/device buffer capacities, and temporary host storage estimates. Apple shared memory overlaps RSS. Record cold creation and first call separately.
scope: Opt-in experimental paths; stable C ABI/GUI defaults retained; keep complete C++/Metal kernels and reference implementations.
design_clarification_before_formal: Overhead workers use separate processes to isolate RSS; block pairing does not eliminate clock/frequency drift.
